keyword: how long will artemis 2 take to get to the moon

verifications.claim: The Artemis 2 mission will take approximately 10 days in total to travel around the Moon and return to Earth.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "approximately 10-day Artemis II mission around the Moon" (R1); "10-day journey around the far side of the moon" (R2); "mission will last approximately 10 days" (R3); "lasting about 10 days" (R4); "journey that will last for more than a week" implying 10 days (R5); "10-day journey around the moon" (R6); "10-day mission" (R7); "about 10 days" (R8); "10-day journey" (R9)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the mission duration as approximately 10 days for the round trip around the Moon.

verifications.claim: The Artemis 2 crew is expected to reach the vicinity of the Moon on the sixth day of the mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "day six of the mission... Artemis II crew will reach the neighborhood of the moon" (R2); "fifth or sixth day... enter the moon's sphere of influence" (R3); "On flight day six" (R4); "get to the moon on the sixth day" (R5); "furthest point... a little more than five days" (R7); "sixth day" (R9)
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently indicate arrival at Moon vicinity on day 5-6, with several specifying sixth day.

verifications.claim: The Artemis 2 crew will reach a maximum distance of about 5,000 miles beyond the lunar far side.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "passing 4,700 miles behind the moon" (R2); "sails 5,000 miles (8,000 kilometers) beyond the moon" (R4); "close to 5,000 miles away from the surface of the moon" (R5); "fly between 4,000 and 6,000 miles" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Direct matches to ~5,000 miles beyond far side; slight variations but precisely supportive.

verifications.claim: The Artemis 2 mission's total duration is approximately 10 days (9 days, 1 hour, and 46 minutes for the full trip).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "splashdown on flight day 10 — nine days, one hour and 46 minutes after liftoff" (R4); "nine days, one hour and 46 minutes after liftoff" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Exact duration specified in references, approximated as 10 days.

verifications.claim: The Artemis 2 crew reaches the Moon on day six.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "day six of the mission... reach the neighborhood of the moon" (R2); "On flight day six" (R4); "get to the moon on the sixth day" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Direct statements of reaching Moon on day six.

verifications.claim: The Artemis 2 spacecraft will perform a "free-return" loop around the far side of the Moon.

verifications.claim: The Artemis 2 mission will not enter a low-lunar orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm no orbit, specifically no low-lunar orbit.

verifications.claim: During the Artemis 2 mission, astronauts will be over 4,000 nautical miles above the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.reasoning: R5 directly uses '4,000 nautical miles'; R8 supports with miles (nautical miles ≈ statute miles in context).

verifications.claim: Astronauts on the Artemis 2 mission will be farther from Earth than any human in history.

verifications.claim: The Artemis 2 journey back from the Moon takes about four days.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "homeward trip will take in excess of 96 hours" (R2, ~4 days); "take up to four days" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: From day 6 to day 10 aligns with ~4 days return; sources specify ~4 days or 96+ hours.
